name: Find top Instagram hashtag posts and draft comments with OpenAI and Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Find top Instagram hashtag posts and draft comments with OpenAI and Google Sheets

### How it works

This workflow runs every day at 9am, reads a configured list of Instagram hashtags, and queries the Instagram Graph API for top posts for each hashtag. It flattens and deduplicates the returned posts, then uses OpenAI to analyze each post and draft suggested comments in a structured format. Relevant results are formatted into digest rows and appended to a Google Sheets spreadsheet.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger timezone and desired run time if 9am is not appropriate.
- In the Config node, set the Instagram user ID, comma-separated hashtags, posts per hashtag, and niche description.
- Provide valid Instagram Graph API access details for the HTTP Request nodes, including permissions to look up hashtags and top media for the configured Instagram user.
- Configure OpenAI credentials for the OpenAI Chat Model sub-node and confirm the structured output schema matches the fields expected by later nodes.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and select the target spreadsheet and sheet in the Append to Digest Sheet node.

### Customization

Adjust the hashtag list, number of posts per hashtag, relevance threshold, prompt instructions, and Google Sheets columns to match the target audience and reporting format.

## Schedule and hashtag setup

Starts the workflow on a daily schedule, defines Instagram search settings, and splits the configured hashtag list into individual items for processing.

## Fetch Instagram posts

Looks up each hashtag ID, retrieves top Instagram posts for that hashtag, and flattens plus deduplicates the returned media into a clean post list.

## Analyze and draft comments

Uses an LLM chain with an OpenAI chat model and structured output parser to evaluate each post and generate comment suggestions.

## Filter and save digest

Merges AI analysis back onto each post, filters for posts that are relevant enough, and appends the final digest rows to Google Sheets.
